name: 62321 · Carthage, IL
findings: ZIP 62321 (Carthage) has 38 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 62321 (Carthage) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
41% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 62321 (Carthage) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).
